description.value: Ocean Park Pizza & Village Pub is a family-owned restaurant and pub anchoring the Ocean Park neighbourhood of South Surrey since 1978, earning multiple readers' choice awards for best pizza and best pub from Lower Mainland newspapers. The Craftsman-style building, rebuilt in 2006, houses a full pub with 20 beers on tap alongside classic pizzas and an expanded menu. Nearly five decades of community involvement — sponsoring local sports teams, youth groups, and charities — make it a genuine neighbourhood institution.

Takeout is confirmed via explicit pickup and third-party delivery mentions. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Ocean Park Pizza' is a shortened version of the full operating name 'Ocean Park Village Pub & Ocean Park Pizza', which is flagged as a concern.
